DISCOVERY 612, APPEARANCES: WILLIAM C. KWONG, ESQ. FOR PLAINTIFF/MOVING PARTY, CECIL SUEN. CAROL SLEETH, ESQ. FOR DEFENDANT/OPPOSING PARTY, CALIFORNIA PACIFIC MEDICAL CENTER. MATTER ARGUED. AFTER ARGUMENT, THE COURT ADOPTED THE TENTATIVE RULING. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR ORDER QUASHING PRODUCTION OF EDD DOCUMENTS IS GRANTED. THE COURT FINDS THAT PLAINTIFF'S RIGHT TO PRIVACY OUTWEIGHS THE PROBATIVE VALUE AND NEED FOR THE DISCOVERY SOUGHT BY THE SUBPOENA. THE COURT ALSO FINDS THAT THE RECORDS ARE BARRED FROM DISCOVERY. SEE RICHARDS V SUPERIOR COURT, 258 CAL.APP.2D 635. PLAINTIFF'S REQUEST FOR SANCTIONS IS DENIED. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT

DISCOVERY 612, NO APPEARANCE. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED. PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL PRODUCTION OF DISCOVERY RESPONSES IS MOOT IN PART AND GRANTED IN PART WITH LIMITATIONS. AS TO THE DOCUMENTS FROM DEFENDANT RENNER'S PERSONNEL FILE, THE MOTION IS GRANTED AS TO REQUEST NO. 5, LIMITED TO DOCUMENTS RELATING TO ANY DISCIPLINARY ACTION OR WARNING GIVEN TO RENNER FOR ENGAGING IN ANY ACTS OF DISCRIMINATION WITHIN THE 5 YEARS PRIOR TO THE INCIDENT TO PRESENT. AS TO NO. 7, DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO IDENTIFY WITH SPECIFICITY THE RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS THAT PREVIOUSLY HAVE BEEN PRODUCED. AS TO THE REMAINDER OF THE ITEMS, THE MOTION IS MOOT. THE COURT WILL NOT DETERMINE THE ADEQUACY OF THE SUPPLEMENTAL PRODUCTION ON THIS MOTION. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO IDENTIFY IN A PRIVILEGE LOG ANY DOCUMENTS WITHHELD PURSUANT TO A CLAIM OF PRIVILEGE. FURTHER PRODUCTION AND THE PRIVILEGE LOG SHALL BE COMPLETED WITHIN 10 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ALL REQUESTS FOR SANCTIONS ARE DENIED. COMM: EVERETT A. HEWLETT
